blast.en: A blast of cold air entered when the classroom door opened.
blast.zh: 教室門打開時，一股冷空氣吹了進來。

combat.en: The campaign uses clear facts to combat false information online.
combat.zh: 這項活動利用清楚的事實來對抗網路上的錯誤資訊。

commander.en: The museum exhibit explains the commander role within an ancient army.
commander.zh: 博物館展覽說明古代軍隊中指揮官的角色。

sob.en: A quiet sob from the character changed the mood of the scene.
sob.zh: 角色輕輕的一聲啜泣改變了整個場景的氣氛。

stroke.en: Each brush stroke added more detail to the landscape painting.
stroke.zh: 每一筆筆觸都為這幅風景畫增添了更多細節。

stun.en: The sudden beauty of the night sky can stun first-time visitors.
stun.zh: 夜空突如其來的美景可能讓第一次來訪的人驚嘆不已。

stupid.en: The teacher explained why calling an idea stupid can stop useful discussion.
stupid.zh: 老師說明為什麼把一個想法說成愚蠢可能會中斷有益的討論。

vanity.en: The novel presents vanity as a weakness that clouds good judgment.
vanity.zh: 這本小說把虛榮描寫成會蒙蔽良好判斷力的弱點。

vice.en: The story treats greed as a vice that harms the whole community.
vice.zh: 故事把貪婪描寫成會傷害整個社群的惡習。

vicious.en: The report describes a vicious cycle of delay and rising costs.
vicious.zh: 這份報告描述了延誤與成本上升形成的惡性循環。

aids.en: The health textbook explains how AIDS affects the human immune system.
aids.zh: 健康課本說明愛滋病如何影響人體免疫系統。

b.c..en: The timeline places this ancient settlement around 500 B.C. in the region.
b.c..zh: 時間軸將這個古代聚落標示在約西元前五百年的此地區。

brew.en: We watched the tea brew slowly while discussing the science of temperature.
brew.zh: 我們一邊看著茶慢慢沖泡，一邊討論溫度的科學原理。

compulsively.en: The novel portrays a character who checks the clock compulsively during meetings.
compulsively.zh: 小說描寫一名在會議中反覆不停看時鐘的角色。

cult.en: The history class examined the word cult in several ancient cultural contexts.
cult.zh: 歷史課從幾個古代文化脈絡中探討 cult 這個詞。

jerk.en: A sudden jerk of the train made several passengers grab the handrail.
jerk.zh: 列車突然一震，讓幾名乘客趕緊抓住扶手。

killer.en: The aquarium sign explains why a killer whale is actually a dolphin.
killer.zh: 水族館的看板說明虎鯨其實屬於海豚的一種。

penicillin.en: The science lesson discussed penicillin while reviewing major medical discoveries.
penicillin.zh: 自然課在複習重要醫學發現時討論了盤尼西林。

satan.en: The literature class discussed satan as a figure in several historical texts.
satan.zh: 文學課討論了撒旦在數篇歷史文本中的角色。

subdue.en: Soft curtains can subdue echoes in the school music room.
subdue.zh: 柔軟的窗簾可以減弱學校音樂教室裡的回音。

vulgar.en: The teacher explained that vulgar language may be inappropriate in formal writing.
vulgar.zh: 老師說明粗俗用語在正式寫作中可能並不適當。

infantry.en: The history map shows where the infantry moved during the ancient campaign.
infantry.zh: 歷史地圖顯示古代戰役中步兵移動的位置。

marshal.en: An event marshal guided visitors toward the correct entrance before the ceremony.
marshal.zh: 活動引導員在典禮前帶領訪客前往正確入口。

cavalry.en: The museum display compares cavalry equipment from several historical periods.
cavalry.zh: 博物館展示比較了數個歷史時期的騎兵裝備。

convoy.en: A relief convoy carried food and blankets to communities after the storm.
convoy.zh: 救援車隊在暴風雨後將食物與毛毯送往各個社區。

regiment.en: The archive preserves letters written by members of one historic regiment.
regiment.zh: 檔案館保存了一支歷史軍團成員所寫的信件。
